source: legacy geometry CSVs, not Item3 centered probe
metric: raw uncentered within-condition value-pair cosine; INT4 minus FP16
unit: one unordered distinct value-string pair per prompt and hidden-state index after mirrored canonical deduplication
token_selection: followup_common.token_span uses prompt.rfind(value); repeated value strings map to their last occurrence; state is mean over overlapping tokens (all supplied spans have length 1)
deduplication: group by seed,attribute,interference_level,trial_idx,layer_index; canonicalize left/right strings lexicographically; collapse exact cosine-equal repeats and mirrored pairs; retain self-pairs caused by repeated values; require every cosine for canonical key identical within each precision; pair precisions on canonical key and verify prompt hashes
uncertainty: none: descriptive means over retained pair rows; pairs share prompts; no independent-pair CIs

cleaned_distinct_pairs_equal_prompt_seed.metric: uncentered cosine of distinct value-string pairs, represented at each strings final occurrence; drop self string pairs; mean pairs within prompt, mean prompts within seed, equal weight five seeds
cleaned_distinct_pairs_equal_prompt_seed.layer_zero: embedding output; subsequent indices HF hidden_states tuple 1..N (final may include output norm)

sensitivity_exclude_repeated_value_promp.weighting_caveat: equal weight only seeds retaining at least one nonrepeated prompt; missing seed(s) not imputed
